items.title: Bahay Kubo

items.title: Leron Leron Sinta
items.suggestedActivity: Lead the class in rhythmic clapping or swaying to develop gross motor coordination and musical tempo.
items.searchQuery: Leron Leron Sinta traditional folk song for kids

items.searchQuery: Paruparong Bukid traditional song for kids

items.suggestedActivity: Pair children up facing one another with hands clasped, gently rocking forward and backward in rhythm.
items.searchQuery: Row Row Row Your Boat traditional nursery rhyme

items.suggestedActivity: Guide children to touch their index finger to opposite thumb in climbing gestures, strengthening the pincer grasp.
items.searchQuery: Itsy Bitsy Spider traditional nursery rhyme

items.suggestedActivity: Reveal animal hand puppets from a barn basket and let children produce each animal's call in unison.
items.searchQuery: Old MacDonald Had a Farm traditional nursery rhyme

items.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
items.suggestedActivity: Place three yarn bags onto a felt board one by one to demonstrate counting and generosity.
items.searchQuery: Baa Baa Black Sheep traditional nursery rhyme

items.title: Humpty Dumpty
items.suggestedActivity: Construct a small foam-brick wall and gently tip a plastic egg over, discussing how friends help fix things safely.
items.searchQuery: Humpty Dumpty traditional nursery rhyme

items.title: Jack and Jill
items.suggestedActivity: Walk up an imaginary foam incline carrying a small sand pail, practicing controlled steps and balance.
items.searchQuery: Jack and Jill traditional nursery rhyme

items.title: Head Shoulders Knees and Toes
items.suggestedActivity: Touch each body part as named, starting at a slow pace and gradually speeding up to enhance focus and agility.
items.searchQuery: Head Shoulders Knees and Toes traditional song for kids

items.title: If You're Happy and You Know It
items.suggestedActivity: Ask learners to invent new verse actions like 'shout hurray' or 'give a wave' to reflect different emotions.
items.searchQuery: If You're Happy and You Know It traditional song for kids

items.title: Five Little Monkeys
items.suggestedActivity: Count down on five fingers, folding one finger down with each verse to visualize subtraction concretely.

items.title: Ten Little Fingers
items.suggestedActivity: Wiggle fingers and toes in response to the lyrics, finishing with a warm round of clapping.
items.searchQuery: Ten Little Fingers and Ten Little Toes song for kids

items.suggestedActivity: Point to a colorful classroom alphabet frieze while singing each letter slowly and clearly.
items.searchQuery: The Alphabet Song traditional ABC song for kids
